title: Biblical Archaeology Review Magazine March April 2006 - When A Woman Ruled Egypt
descriptionText:
Explore the fascinating world of ancient Egypt and its women rulers with this issue of Biblical Archaeology Review. Published in 2006, this bimonthly magazine is a treasure trove of knowledge on the prehistoric and philosophical aspects of the region. 

Delve into the pages of this illustrated magazine to discover the secrets of when a woman ruled Egypt. With features on the history of women in power and the archaeology of the region, this original copy is a must-have for anyone interested in the topic.
